sentences.en: The poor dog was literally torn apart by the lion.
sentences.zh: 那条可怜的狗被狮子撕得粉碎。

sentences.en: The detective questioned literally thousands of people about the incident.
sentences.zh: 侦探就这次事件询问了成千上万的人。

sentences.en: This, of course, does not have to be taken literally.

senses.zh: 逐字地；照字面地确实地，真正地
